import numpy as np
d = np.load('source_pixels.npz')
rgb = d['rgb']
R,G,B = rgb[...,0].astype(int), rgb[...,1].astype(int), rgb[...,2].astype(int)
mask = (G>140)&(R>120)&(B<120)&(G-R>-10)&(R-B>40)&(G-B>60)
pos=[]
for i in range(96):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(mask[i])
    pos.append((xs.mean(), ys.mean()))
pos=np.array(pos)
np.save('[workspace path]', pos)
# aerial fit frames 0..27 (t in seconds)
dt=1/24
t=np.arange(96)*dt
ax=t[:28]; X=pos[:28,0]; Y=pos[:28,1]
# x linear
A=np.vstack([np.ones_like(ax),ax]).T
cx=np.linalg.lstsq(A,X,rcond=None)[0]
# y quadratic
Ay=np.vstack([np.ones_like(ax),ax,ax**2]).T
cy=np.linalg.lstsq(Ay,Y,rcond=None)[0]
print('x fit: x0=%.3f vx0=%.3f px/s'%(cx[0],cx[1]))
print('y fit: y0=%.3f vy0=%.3f g=%.3f px/s2'%(cy[0],cy[1],2*cy[2]))
# residuals
xp=cx[0]+cx[1]*ax; yp=cy[0]+cy[1]*ax+cy[2]*ax**2
print('x resid max',np.abs(xp-X).max(),'y resid max',np.abs(yp-Y).max())
# ground level
print('ground y mean frames 80-95:', pos[80:,1].mean())
# rolling: frames 29..80, inspect dx
dx=np.diff(pos[28:82,0])
print('rolling dx per frame:', np.round(dx,2))
tt=np.arange(len(dx))
# constant decel fit: v = v0 + a*tframe
Ac=np.vstack([np.ones_like(tt),tt]).T
cLin=np.linalg.lstsq(Ac,dx,rcond=None)[0]
print('linear v fit v0=%.3f a=%.4f px/frame2, resid max %.3f'%(cLin[0],cLin[1],np.abs(dx-(cLin[0]+cLin[1]*tt)).max()))
# exp fit
logv=np.log(dx)
cExp=np.linalg.lstsq(Ac,logv,rcond=None)[0]
pred=np.exp(cExp[0]+cExp[1]*tt)
print('exp fit v0=%.3f k=%.4f, resid max %.3f'%(np.exp(cExp[0]),cExp[1],np.abs(pred-dx).max()))
